args.query: Was there a FedEx delivery disruption in Phoenix, Arizona on or around 2024-05-14?

content.summary: No documented FedEx delivery disruption affecting Phoenix on or within two days of May 14, 2024 was found; FedEx’s May 14 notice concerned a test-environment API interruption, while the listed production interruption was May 18–19.

basis.reasoning: FedEx’s announcement identifies the May 14 interruption as affecting its test environment. It lists the production-environment interruption separately as May 18–19, outside the two-day window. The notice therefore does not document a delivery disruption in Phoenix on the requested date.

citations.title: May 2024 - Interruption Announcement

basis.reasoning: The official notice distinguishes the May 14 test-environment interruption from the production interruption scheduled for May 18–19, supporting the summary that the May 14 item was not a documented Phoenix delivery disruption.
